source.code:
/--
Creates a new empty tree set. It is also possible and recommended to
use the empty collection notations `∅` and `{}` to create an empty tree set. `simp` replaces
`empty` with `∅`.
-/
@[inline]
def empty : TreeSet α cmp :=
  ⟨TreeMap.empty⟩
